composite_policy_and_rate_configmap_hote.description: Two independent faults on different services: a deny-all NetworkPolicy isolates recommendation, and mongodb-rate cannot start without its init-script ConfigMap.

composite_frontend_selector_and_readines.description: Two causes, one symptom, one service: Service/frontend selects no pods, and frontend's readiness probe never succeeds.

composite_geo_configmap_with_log_drift_h.description: A fault plus a misleading benign drift: mongodb-geo cannot start without its init-script ConfigMap, while geo carries a fresh, harmless LOG_LEVEL=debug change.

composite_user_target_port_and_geo_image.description: The user Service routes to the wrong port while the geo Deployment uses an unavailable image.

composite_rate_service_and_geo_image_hot.description: The mongodb-rate Service is absent while the geo Deployment uses an unavailable image.

composite_user_target_port_and_rate_serv.description: The user Service routes to the wrong port while the mongodb-rate Service is absent.
